versionImpact.rationale: Configured release version updates now preserve repository-owned TOML formatting and treat already-matching JSON or TOML version state as a semantic no-op.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Parser-verified lossless TOML edits prevent formatter-only release-preparation commits while real version changes and strict transaction source identity remain enforced.

summary: Buildchain v2.11 avoids formatter-only generated promotion commits by preserving TOML source formatting and skipping semantic version-state no-ops.
